validation_rules: the orchestrator derives record ids, citations, evidence classes and exposure labels; the reply carries judgment only
a reference that names no base DFD, wave-1, component or brief id becomes a gap
an evidence ref that does not resolve becomes a gap; a record left with no resolvable evidence is kept as WEAK_INFERENCE
text matching the prohibited-claim patterns (verified finding, severity level, compliance verdict, observed runtime, remediated) drops the record and becomes a gap
